summary: No polygon-interior overlap was detected by the corrected screening method. Boundary-only contact does not count as interior overlap; a geometric trigger would require review and would not imply shared historical control.
method: Compare source GeoJSON longitude/latitude polygon rings valid in the year using strictly interior edge samples and proper boundary-segment crossings; boundary-only contacts are excluded.
runtimeDisposition: No source outline is held by this overlap audit. Original source geometries and validity intervals remain unchanged; this result does not validate the historical accuracy of those low-confidence interval models.

sourceNotes.use: Compared polygons are Cliopatria v0.2.1 source records (CC BY 4.0), labeled low-confidence interval models with unspecified control type. Geometric intersection alone does not prove direct control, disputed control, or a historical frontier. Preserve attribution and provenance; historical suitability and public display require separate review.

reviewLimitations: The screen detects geometric area overlap only; it does not identify historical control or an authoritative boundary.
No detected overlap does not establish that a source interval polygon is a historically accurate annual frontier.
Source geometries are preserved and are not clipped, split, or reassigned.
supersedes: Earlier contact-sensitive preflight counts for this year. Boundary-only contacts are excluded from interior-overlap findings.
